answers.core: It's a small and central change to Godot's functionality and affects a big portion of games created with it.
answers.workaround: The only workaround I found is to create another viewport inside a ViewportContainer and use that to scale up the drawing. I don't think it's a reasonable workaround, and there are plenty of pixel art games made in Godot that can't make use of custom drawing as it is.

title: Give an option to scale custom drawing like the rest of the viewport
